# OutdoorGPT

## Project Overview
OutdoorGPT is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that enables AI assistants to help users discover and plan outdoor recreation activities. It integrates three APIs: National Park Service, Recreation.gov, and OpenWeatherMap.

## Key Features
- 9 MCP tools for outdoor recreation discovery
- National parks search and detailed information
- Campground and recreation area discovery
- Real-time weather data and forecasts
- Park alerts and safety information
- Facility details and amenities
- Activity listings and recommendations

## Target Users
- Claude Desktop users seeking outdoor recreation information
- Developers building AI-powered travel and recreation applications
- Outdoor enthusiasts planning trips and activities

## Technology Stack
- Language: Go 1.25+
- Protocol: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Containerization: Docker with security hardening
- APIs: NPS, Recreation.gov (RIDB), OpenWeatherMap
- Architecture: Clean, simple, fast design philosophy

## MCP Tools Available
1. search_parks - Find national parks by location or activity
2. get_park_details - Detailed park information including hours and fees
3. get_park_alerts - Current alerts and closures
4. search_campgrounds - Find campgrounds in parks
5. search_recreation_areas - Discover recreation areas
6. get_facility_details - Detailed facility information
7. get_weather - Current weather conditions
8. get_weather_forecast - 5-day weather forecasts
9. list_activities - Available activities across all sources

## Installation
Requires API keys from:
- National Park Service (https://www.nps.gov/subjects/developer/)
- Recreation.gov (https://ridb.recreation.gov/)
- OpenWeatherMap (https://openweathermap.org/api)

Can be run via Docker or native Go installation.
